heading: Rule 5 — Settings compose by intersection
text:
### Rule 5 — Settings compose by intersection [LCAP.3.5]

Each restricting setting (a strategy capability set to restrict, or a
construct capability set `false`) removes programs from the set of valid
ones. A program must satisfy the restrictions of every setting it has
simultaneously; one that fails any of them does not compile, whatever its
other settings.

No setting relaxes a restriction another imposes. The only "interaction"
is LCAP.3.1 (`linear_scan: false` with `logical: false` → alpha mode),
which is a consequence of two restrictions combining, not a relaxation.
